items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So I got a show with Wingy Manone, Volly Faux Defoe

ctx.x: On that show, a few months before, I'd met a bunch of guys, I knew all the jazz guys in Chicago, they begin to know me and know that I was playing that way. So I got a show with Wingy Manone, Volly Faux Defoe --
